title: GTA VI Pre-Order Support: Retailer, Receipt and Refund Guide
summary: What to check for GTA VI pre-orders, retailer delivery questions and digital code issues.
intro: GTA VI launches November 19, and players have several purchase channels: console storefronts, the Rockstar Store and other retailers. If an order is delayed, missing or incorrectly described, the first step is identifying which business accepted payment. Rockstar's support FAQ distinguishes purchase support from other retailers' own order responsibilities, so one universal refund rule would be misleading.

sections.heading: Identify the seller on your receipt
paragraphs: A console storefront purchase generally uses the platform's purchase-support process, while a retail order has its own invoice and fulfillment terms. Rockstar's support page directs questions about purchases made from other retailers to those retailers. Save the order number, date, edition and listed platform. Do not send complete bank-card details or account passwords when asking a seller to confirm a legitimate order.

sections.heading: Check whether you bought a code or a physical item
paragraphs: Rockstar has said the GTA VI boxed version contains a download code rather than a disc. That distinction affects what a customer should expect to receive. A shipping notice for a box does not mean the game is already installed, and a digital download code may still require account-region compatibility. Confirm the product type before claiming something is missing.

sections.heading: Timing depends on the channel
paragraphs: The newer dedicated digital pre-load guidance specifies November 10, while other materials refer to physical package availability around November 12. A retailer can have different pickup and shipping schedules. Do not assume a box arriving before launch allows the game to be played immediately. If a delivery estimate changes, consult the seller's order tracking rather than treating a countdown on social media as authoritative.

sections.heading: Refund conditions are provider-specific
paragraphs: Digital purchases, unused codes and shipped physical products can be governed by different refund policies. Do not promise that a code can always be returned after redemption, and do not assume every pre-order is non-refundable. Read the rules for the specific storefront, region and order state. Keep correspondence and invoice details in case the provider asks for evidence of an incorrect charge or failed fulfillment.

sections.heading: Avoid third-party activation scams
paragraphs: A stranger offering to activate a purchase through remote console access or one-time codes is not an ordinary support channel. Do not disclose recovery information, payment authorization messages or passwords. Use your own supported account and payment provider processes. If the offer describes a PC launch copy for November 19, remember that Rockstar's current confirmed launch platforms are PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
